items.name: Tenshi-Do Cowabunga School Holiday Program
items.suburb: Ravenhall, near Caroline Springs (Unit 5/94 Eucumbene Drive)
items.description: Holiday program at Tenshi-Do Martial Arts, 8.30am–5.30pm, open to students, siblings and friends: karate and gymnastics drills and games, Wii sports, movies and colouring. Book 6 days and the final 2 are free (same child). Bring lunch, snacks, a named water bottle and a change of clothes. Book by messaging the form to 0402 203 567 or tenshidoma@gmail.com.

items.name: Hannah Watts Park

items.name: JUMP! Swim Schools Truganina
items.description: Boutique heated indoor pool at 2/25 Infinity Drive; parent-and-child classes from 6 months to 4 years, then independent swimmers and stroke development. JUMP's website lists this centre as coming soon, so check before booking.

items.name: Baby Bounce, Melton City Libraries
items.description: Stories and songs for babies 0–12 months. Caroline Springs Library: Tue 10–10.30am and Wed 11.30am–12pm; Melton Library: Tue and Wed 11.30am–12pm. School terms, no booking.

items.name: After Schooligans, Melton City Libraries
items.description: After-school crafts, games, reading and STEM for ages 5–12, Tuesdays 3.45–4.30pm at Melton and Caroline Springs libraries during school terms. No booking.

items.name: Family Tales, Melton City Libraries
items.description: Saturday stories, songs and rhymes for families with children 0–8, one Saturday a month 11–11.30am at both library hubs.

items.name: Burnside Busy Kids Playgroup
items.description: Community playgroup for families with children 0–5 at Burnside Children's & Community Centre, 23 Lexington Drive. Mondays 10.30am–12pm.

items.name: YMCA Kororoit Creek Playgroup
items.description: Playgroup at 5 Millport Drive, Tuesdays 10am–12pm during school terms.

items.name: Diggers Rest Playgroup
items.description: Playgroup with arts and crafts for children 0–5 at Diggers Rest Sports & Community Pavilion (cnr Plumpton Rd and Houdini Dr). Thursdays 10am–12pm, school term.

items.name: Mums and Bubs Playgroup, Plumpton Children's & Community Centre
items.description: Indoor and outdoor playgroup at 19 Pear Parade, Fraser Rise. Tuesdays 12.30–2pm.

items.name: Melton Enjoy Playgroup
items.description: Playgroup for children 0–5 at 11 Navigation Drive with free entry, tea/coffee and arts and crafts. Thursdays 10–11.30am.

items.name: Botanica Springs Playgroup
items.description: Community playgroup at Botanica Springs Children's & Community Centre, 249 Clarkes Road. Thursdays 9.30–11.30am, school term.

items.name: Melton West Primary School Playgroup
items.description: Playgroup at Melton West Primary, 2–16 Rathdowne Circuit. Tuesdays 8.50–11am and Wednesdays 8.50am–12pm.

items.name: Arnolds Creek Grandparents Playgroup
items.description: Playgroup for grandparents and grandkids at Arnolds Creek Children's and Community Centre, Claret Ash Blvd. Fridays 9.30–11am.

items.name: Gather and Grow Playgroup
items.description: Free play-based playgroup hosted by Aspire Early Education at 52 Dorchester Street, with morning tea provided. Tuesdays 10–11.30am, all year including school holidays.

items.name: Weir Views Community Activation Playgroup
items.description: Free playgroup at Weir Views Children's & Community Centre, 23 Pegasus Road. Tuesdays 12.30–2pm during Term 4 2026; bookings required.

items.name: PlayConnect Playgroup
items.description: Free supported playgroup for children 0–5 with autism, developmental delays or behavioural concerns, at West Melton Children's and Community Centre. Tuesdays 10am–12pm, school term.

items.name: Rhyme Time, Truganina Library Lounge
items.description: Wyndham City Libraries stories, songs and rhymes for ages 1–5 at Truganina Community Centre, 1 Everton Road. Tuesdays and Wednesdays 10.30–11am.

items.name: Baby Time, Truganina Library Lounge
items.description: Songs, rhymes and finger plays for babies 12 months and under. Wednesdays 2pm and Thursdays 10.30am (Term 2 2026 timetable).

items.name: Multicultural Playgroup, Truganina Community Centre
items.description: Free VICSEG New Futures playgroup for migrant and refugee families at 1 Everton Road. Mondays 10am–12pm.

items.name: FLIP Gymnastics Holiday Program (Truganina)
items.description: Gymnastics skills, games, craft and free play for school-aged kids, 9.30am–2pm; Truganina sessions run on Mondays of each break. Bring lunch.

items.name: Wyndham Active Holidays
items.suburb: Truganina, Point Cook, Werribee and more
items.description: Free council-run active sessions each school holiday with community providers; timetable published two weeks before each break.

items.name: Hillside Recreation Reserve

items.name: Broughton Avenue Reserve
items.description: Play equipment including a rock climbing wall, slide and sandpit, water play for warmer days, BBQ and a walking/cycling path.

items.name: Kurunjang Recreation Reserve

items.name: Frontier Park (Aintree Recreation Reserve)

items.name: Mushu Street Reserve

items.name: Barwon Street Reserve

items.name: Melton City Libraries school holiday program

items.name: Melton Music holiday workshops

items.name: Mawson Gardens
items.description: 46 Wright Circuit park with play equipment, BBQ and picnic facilities, shelter, seating, drinking fountain and car park.

items.name: Cypress Views Village Park

items.name: St Georges Avenue Reserve

items.name: Taylors Hill Central Park
items.description: 2A The Walk. Playground mostly under shade sails, with BBQs, picnic tables and a drinking fountain. Council upgrade (including water play) was due to start mid-2026.

items.name: Parkwood Green Reserve
items.description: 88-94 Catherine Drive. Playground, BBQ area, basketball and tennis courts, exercise equipment and a pavilion.

items.name: Warringah Reserve
items.description: Glenbruar Drive. Play space upgraded in 2026 with a multiplay unit, carousel, basket swings, monkey bars and frame climber.

items.name: Arnolds Creek Recreation Reserve
items.description: 37 Claret Ash Boulevard. Natural play space with dry creek bed and sensory garden, play tower with rope climbing and slides, flying fox, accessible spinner, BBQ and toilets.

items.name: Norm Raven Reserve
items.description: 28-38 Glitter Road. Playground closed for an upgrade; council expects completion in November 2026. Also BBQ, picnic tables and a basketball half court.
